Position Summary 		   Employment start:  October 2026
Duration:  3 months
Duties & Responsibilities:
• Support   the  Deputy Team Leader/Project Manager/Senior Coordinator   on  daily tasks, including organising events, preparing   their  materials, engaging stakeholders, facilitating   the  events, collecting feedback   and  writing minutes   or  reports.
• Work   and  communicate   with  key stakeholders   in  the national   and  provincial government, local   and  national private sector players   on  matters pertaining   to  the implementation   of  the projects.
• Travel   to  the fields   to  support implementation   and  assessment   of  activities under   the  two projects.
• Review administration   and  finance documents   and  communicate   with  the finance team   and  DGTVET   to  address   the  issues   related  to   the  documents.
• Technical translation oral   and  written, Khmer   to  English   and  vice versa.
• Build   and  maintain good relationships   with  Swisscontact team   and  other relevant stakeholders.
• Conduct field visits   to  monitor   the  progress   and  results   of  intervention implementation.
• Support team   and  partners   to  collect   data  and regularly update   the  SDP database.
• Provide guidance   for  partners   in  data   collection  and monitoring techniques.
• Ensure   high  quality   of  service provided   to  learners by providing technical review   and  feedback   on  findings   and  recommendations   and  ensuring adequate follow-up.
• Execute other duties assigned by   the  Management Team.
Benefits:
• Swisscontact offers attractive   working  conditions   in  an international   and  multicultural context. We see our   work  as   a  joint effort   in  an agile organizational culture: mutual respect, trust   and  teamwork.
Expected Profile of Candidates
Languages:
• Khmer  - Fluent
• English  - Fluent
Qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree   in  project management, internation relation, finance, accountant, administration   or  related fields.
Skills & Knowledge:
General & Technical Skills
• Understanding   project  management
• Willing   to  learn   the  project financial process
• Present good communication, patience, coordination   and  facilitation   skills  for partnership   and  cooperation development.
• Understanding   on  TVET system   and  policies   is  a plus.
• Strong Khmer   and  English competency   in  all skills, speaking, listening, writing   and  translation.
• Good computer literacy   skills  are required
Soft Skills
• Ability   to  work independently   and  manage tasks assigned   in  context   of  flexibility   and  time pressure.
• Demonstrates adaptability   and  strong problem-solving skills.
